subject.title: feat(system-agent): agentic cached caretaker greeting with quick actions

question: Should the default system-agent welcome adopt a cached model-inference caretaker identity with persisted greeting and audit-delivery state as part of the system-agent overhaul?
rationale: The implementation is an optional user-facing behavior and introduces a recurring model-backed startup path plus durable state semantics; source review alone cannot determine whether that is the intended long-term product boundary.

options.title: Approve the scoped caretaker phase
options.body: Accept the cached model-backed welcome after redacted runtime proof confirms deterministic fallback, cache reuse, and delivery-safe audit acknowledgement.

options.title: Keep the welcome deterministic
options.body: Retain the existing deterministic overview path and defer model identity plus persisted greeting state until the wider overhaul has explicit product approval.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped caretaker phase
recommendation.body: Accept the cached model-backed welcome after redacted runtime proof confirms deterministic fallback, cache reuse, and delivery-safe audit acknowledgement.
